dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: Those two weirdos are up to it again...

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: I often see them coming here to read, but I never expected to encounter them during Lantern Rite as well.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: All I hear them talking about is "evil spirits" or somesuch, though. Are they writing a story, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best of luck to you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: Thank you! Frogs are super hard to catch, though...

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: So far all I've managed to grab is a few lizards, and even then only the tails...

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: Maybe you could take them? I've gotta keep trying to catch a frog, and I definitely can't do it with my hands full of lizard tails.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: Excuse me, have you seen my frog?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What frog?

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: I just caught a frog, and his back was really slippy, and then I let him get away by accident.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: He's a lively little froggie, I was lucky to catch him the first time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: Byeee!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you want the frog for?

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: I wanna give him to my little sister to play with.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: My sister is that girl over there, the one who is always trying to catch her shadow... even though you can't catch your shadow. I don't get why she likes to do that...

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: Maybe she just feels bored. At least if I catch her a frog, chasing him will be more fun than chasing her shadow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you play with her?

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: I think she doesn't like me very much. She doesn't wanna listen to anything I say, let alone play with me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: I don't get it, I'm always trying my bestest to find her things she wants, so why won't she be happy with me?
